Hero.title: A children's language-learning university designed around just 5 minutes a day.
Hero.subtitle: A calm, voice-based ecosystem where your child naturally acquires fluency and trust through daily conversational roleplay. No screens to stare at. Just immersive, structured learning.

practice.title: Conversational Practice
practice.description: Children build spontaneous speaking habits and genuine confidence rather than relying on passive listening.

parent.title: Parent Involvement
parent.description: A transparent system to track real fluency growth and engage with offline connection challenges.

anxietyFree.title: Anxiety-Free Space
anxietyFree.description: A warm, patient AI companion that feels human, ensuring your child loves returning every day.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Answers to common questions about our 5-minute daily language university.

q1.question: How long is a daily session?
q1.answer: Each mission is strictly 5 minutes. This creates a fast-paced cognitive threshold that prevents burnout and keeps your child excited for the next day.

q2.question: Does my child need to know how to read?
q2.answer: Not at all. The entire ecosystem is voice-based conversational roleplay. They simply listen and speak to their AI companion.
